fields.scope: Owner, month, environment, route and job
fields.idempotency_key: Same external effect cannot reserve twice
fields.price_snapshot: Provider, model, region, rate version and checked time
fields.worst_case_gross_usd: Decimal: inputs, maximum outputs, tools, cache writes, retries and batch liability
fields.verified_credit_allocation_id: Nullable. When absent, optional Claude dispatch is refused.
fields.reserved_credit_usd: Decimal. MP-local reservation against a proven allocated slice only; zero admissible credit until trustworthy organisation-wide allocation and freshness are established.
fields.fx_bound_gbp_per_usd: Decimal conservative conversion with source age
fields.tax_card_bounds: Decimal fractions, linked to invoice evidence or explicit assumptions
fields.worst_case_cash_gbp: Decimal cash liability after verified eligible credit
fields.expires_at: Admission expiry; not proof that external billing stopped
fields.org_wide_credit_allocation_proof: Required, currently unproven evidence of a cooperative or otherwise enforceable allocation and coverage despite other applications. MP-local records cannot control unrelated spending.

invariants: Global, environment and route reservations change atomically under concurrency.
Without sufficient verified credit, refuse optional Claude regardless of cash headroom.

Cross-application exclusion of consumed, reserved and uncertain credits is a required organisation-wide cooperative/enforceable capability, currently unproven. MP-local reservations alone cannot provide it; without trustworthy allocation and freshness proof, refuse optional Claude dispatch.
Settlement replaces reservation liability; it does not double-count the same expense.
Fixed subscriptions remain committed until cancellation is effective.
Counterfactual full-function no-credit costs are not permitted paid-call forecasts.
Expiry, scope, freshness or coverage failure denies model dispatch.
Emergency policy does not bypass owner authority or the GBP100 aggregate envelope.

credit_proof_boundary.distinction: Usage/billing collection cadence is separate from the proposed admission-proof freshness bound. If trustworthy proof cannot be obtained, deny dispatch.
